# GitHub repository setup

Use these values after the first upload to finish the repository presentation in GitHub's **About** and **Social preview** settings.

## About

**Description**

```text
Explore football matches around the world on an interactive 3D globe — with match discovery, Retro mode, broadcasts and highlights.
```

**Website**

```text
https://footglobe.discloud.app
```

**Suggested topics**

```text
football
soccer
threejs
3d-globe
nextjs
typescript
react
football-data
live-scores
retro-football
webapp
i18n
```

## Social preview

Upload this file in **Settings → General → Social preview**:

```text
public/footglobe-social-preview.png
```

## Recommended repository options

- Keep **Issues** enabled so the included bug/feature templates work.
- Keep **Actions** enabled so `.github/workflows/ci.yml` can validate pushes and pull requests.
- Enable **Private vulnerability reporting** under **Settings → Security** if available.
- Optionally enable branch protection for `main` after the first successful CI run.
